Glad it's useful. When you're ready, I can help with any of these next steps:

- **Draft a section.** Share your program details and I'll write a first pass of the Statement of Need or Program Design, which together are 60% of the score.
- **Build the logic model.** Give me your activities and intended outcomes, and I'll lay out inputs → activities → outputs → outcomes.
- **Write SMART objectives.** I'll turn your goals into measurable outcomes with baselines and targets.
- **Check the budget.** I'll review your line items and draft the justification and cost-per-participant language.
- **Review a draft against the rubric.** Paste any section and I'll score it the way a reviewer would and flag gaps.

Good luck with the application.
